subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open fork PR or close/supersede it before a fresh current-main fix is queued for this Debug Snapshots issue?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-reproducible, but an open dirty fork PR still uses closing syntax, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the PR path.

options.title: Close or supersede the fork path
options.body: Close or supersede the dirty fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current `ui/src/pages/debug` files.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch and repair it against the current Debug page/view structure before review.

options.title: Wait on the fork author
options.body: Keep the issue blocked on the existing fork PR, accepting that no new ClawSweeper fix should be queued meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Close or supersede the fork path
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the dirty fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current `ui/src/pages/debug` files.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest provenance on the original Debug dashboard behavior and is the best available owner for deciding whether to replace or adopt the fork path.
